noStatus: The controller has written no status. It may not be running, or it runs with --update-status=false.
stale: The controller has not processed the latest change yet: the status is of an older generation.

hint.noKey: No sealing key of this controller decrypts it: it was sealed with another controller's certificate, or for another name, namespace or scope (renaming or moving a strict SealedSecret breaks it). Seal it again with kubeseal against this controller.
hint.unmanaged: A Secret with this name already exists and is not managed by this SealedSecret. Add the annotation sealedsecrets.bitnami.com/managed: "true" to that Secret to let the controller take it over, or delete the Secret.
hint.immutable: The Secret is immutable, so its data cannot be changed. Delete the Secret and the controller creates it again.
hint.legacyData: It uses the deprecated field spec.data. Seal it again with kubeseal to get spec.encryptedData.
